topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The walls seem thinner now, don’t they? I can almost hear the whispers of what used to be just the hum of the building, the familiar creaks that told me I was part of something larger, stable. Now, those sounds are different—foreign, like the low murmur of a crowd at the edge of a playground I can’t enter. The air is different, too, colder, as if the warmth that seeped through the bricks and mortar, the shared breath of all who lived here, is being siphoned away. Changes, they say, but I keep seeing the same faces, the ones that used to nod hello, wondering if they, too, feel the chill, if they, too, see the shadows growing longer on the walls that once felt like home.
